—Issue No. 136—
<style="stress">[Early Signs of the Hall of Ancients Conspiracy!]</style>
<style="stress">[Peggy Hides After Plot Exposed!]</style>
By: Brown Bear

Was the Hypofiend onslaught in the Hall of Ancients truly an accident? Through exclusive interviews with multiple eyewitnesses, we have uncovered a shocking allegation: Princess Peggy's attempt to draw Excalibur was not an act of desperation, but a long-planned bid for the throne!

"The situation wasn't nearly that critical," a noble present at the scene stated. "The Hypofiends caused some disruption, but not enough to warrant the use of Excalibur." This indicates that while things were still under control, Princess Peggy's first thought was to reach for the sword that signifies royal authority.

Was that really a spur-of-the-moment act? For more information, we managed to locate a court tutor who once instructed the princess. She confirmed, "The princess had little interest in the history of the royal family, but recently, she's shown an unusual enthusiasm for the Excalibur ceremony and inquiring about its details with multiple people."

Now, the truth is beginning to emerge. The Hypofiend attack was highly likely just a pretext to legitimize the princess' contact with the sacred sword, allowing her to bypass the prince in the line of succession and seize the throne.

The divine manifestation of King Rolan may be interpreted as a warning against the alleged scheme. As for Princess Peggy's disappearance, it may not have been accidental, but rather a deliberate choice to vanish and evade public condemnation.

A meticulously orchestrated power play was derailed by an ancestor's wrath. What course of action will the Queen and her daughter take next?

Peer into the royal family's power play with The Savannah Eye!

—第136期—
<style="stress">【圣古堂阴谋早有预兆！】</style>
<style="stress">【夺权阴谋败露，佩吉不愿出现！】</style>
本报记者棕熊
圣古堂的悲剧，真的是由几只魔物引发的意外吗？本报通过对多位目击者的秘密采访，发现了一个惊人的事实：佩吉公主拔剑的举动，并非情急之下的无奈之举，而是一场蓄谋已久的夺权行动!
“当时的情况根本没有那么危险！”一位现场的贵族向我们透露，“那几只魔物虽然造成了些混乱，但远未到需要动用圣剑的地步。”然而，正是在这种可控的局面下，佩吉公主却临时起意，第一时间将主意打到了那柄象征着王权的圣剑之上！
这真的是临时起意吗？本报找到了另一位关键证人——一位曾教导过佩吉公主的宫廷教师。她证实：“公主殿下往日对枯燥的王室历史毫无兴趣，但近来却一反常态，对圣剑擢选仪式表现出异乎寻常的热情，并向多人打探仪式的细节。”
至此，整个阴谋的脉络已经清晰：利用一场小小的魔物骚乱作为借口，在众目睽睽之下“合法”地触碰圣剑，并试图一举拔出，从而绕过王子，完成对王权的窃取！
先王罗兰大帝的圣迹正是对这场阴谋的警告。而佩吉公主后续的失踪，或许根本不是意外，而是她在阴谋败露后，羞于或不敢再面对世人，从而选择了主动躲藏！
一场精心策划的夺权大戏，因先祖的震怒而中断。接下来，这对母女又将上演怎样的戏码？
《赛凡纳之眼》将持续为您深挖王座之下的黑暗!
